title: Ledger record: claim
description: A proposition whose authority and provenance are explicit (PRD §10.2). A claim produced by an agent is `proposed` until an authorized review confirms it; an agent saying "done" is a completion claim, not verified evidence (PRD §10.5).

data.$comment: Phase 0: payload shape is deliberately loose. Named properties are optional and documentary; a later task pins the payload contract per record type.

sources.description: Where this claim's content came from — a web page, a document, a person, a prior ledger record. Generic to every domain the decompose pipeline (task t24, issue #45) runs on: a claim decomposed from a code plan may cite none, a claim scoped from the web should cite at least one. internal/ledger's VerifyClaimChain reads this property to check that a claim is sourced; the property is documentary like every other Phase-0 payload field, so an existing claim record with no sources stays valid, it is simply reported unsourced.
